from collections import Counter
def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for row in g for x in row)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    nb=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]!=bg]
    # connected components (4-conn) of non-bg
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for r,c in nb:
        if (r,c) in seen: continue
        st=[(r,c)]; comp=[]
        while st:
            a,b=st.pop()
            if (a,b) in seen: continue
            seen.add((a,b)); comp.append((a,b))
            for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                x,y=a+da,b+db
                if 0<=x<h and 0<=y<w and g[x][y]!=bg and (x,y) not in seen:
                    st.append((x,y))
        comps.append(comp)
    comps.sort(key=len, reverse=True)
    patcomp=comps[0]
    markers=[c for comp in comps[1:] for c in comp]
    rs=[r for r,c in patcomp]; cs=[c for r,c in patcomp]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    ph,pw=r1-r0+1,c1-c0+1
